name: verified-rmd-excess-reinvested-survivor-rollover
description: Fixture rules, MFJ: SS and a pension exceed the need, so the RMD (after tax) is reinvested in the taxable account; the older IRA owner dies in 2029 (survivor SS step-up, survivor reduction), and the survivor's age (73) governs RMDs on the IRA; MFJ in 2029, single from 2030 (§7.1, §7.7).
